title: HOE dashboard main script did not parse from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-26; Epic V M5.2 marked done on controls that never acted on the simulation
what_went_wrong: Commit fd96038 (Epic IV M4.2 charts) left three Chart.js options objects without a closing brace; the whole dashboard <script> failed to parse, so no panel refreshed.
Epic V M5.2 pause/resume and 1x/2x/5x were ticked done: they only changed the browser poll interval (the world kept stepping), and the speed <select> onchange had a stray quote.
root_cause: No syntax or smoke check of public/*.html in CI or tests; roadmap items were ticked from code presence, not from running the app.
detection: Epic V audit 2026-10-26 (vm.Script parse of the inline script; main had the same error).
impact: The single-page dashboard was non-functional for 19 days; ROADMAP overstated Epic V.

correction.applied: Branch epic-v-dashboard commit 0d60971: braces fixed, real run controller (/api/sim/*), SSE /api/stream, verified in the running app; ROADMAP marks corrected.
correction.result: Open until merged; suggested follow-up: a test that parses every inline <script> in public/*.html.

rule: Mark a UI roadmap item done only after exercising it in the running app; parse-check inline scripts in the test suite.
